name: Gunman Contracts: Chapter 2 - Art of War
summary:
The unknown Gun-for-Hire returns to take on a much larger human trafficking operation and the man behind it. Infiltrate a private Art Exhibition and blast your way through a heavily guarded skyscraper from lobby to roof to retrieve the information needed to save hundreds of lives.

The original mod release before being remade as Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone.
